cards.intuition: The boundary decision decides dictionary keys, postings, positions, and highlights. It is a retrieval model, not cosmetic string splitting.

cards.intuition: Preserve an identifier like node.js while also emitting node and js when both exact and component queries matter.

cards.topic: Tokenization Choices and Their Retrieval Consequences

cards.intuition: Changing boundaries changes the vocabulary and all downstream statistics. Version, evaluate, rebuild, and cut over deliberately.

cards.intuition: Merge morphological variants to recover more relevant forms, but risk merging distinct concepts into one noisy postings list.
cards.formula: stemming usually raises recall and can lower precision
cards.topic: When Stemming Helps Recall and Hurts Precision

cards.intuition: Overstemming joins meanings that should stay separate; understemming leaves true relatives apart. Domain language determines the harm.
cards.formula: overstem = false equivalence; understem = missed equivalence
cards.topic: When Stemming Helps Recall and Hurts Precision

cards.intuition: Keep surface precision and stem recall as separate signals instead of destroying one to obtain the other.
cards.formula: score = weighted exact-field match + weighted stem-field match
cards.topic: When Stemming Helps Recall and Hurts Precision

cards.intuition: Dropping frequent words saves postings, but removes evidence needed for exact phrases, names, and citations.
cards.formula: space saving trades against phrase and entity capability
cards.topic: Stop Words: Space Savings vs Phrase-Query Damage

cards.intuition: If middle stop words are omitted, retained terms must keep their original distance or the index invents adjacency.
cards.formula: state of the art → positions state:1, art:4
cards.topic: Stop Words: Space Savings vs Phrase-Query Damage

cards.intuition: A common word contributes little to most topics but can define The Who, The Hague, or an exact legal phrase.
cards.formula: low average idf does not mean zero contextual value
cards.topic: Stop Words: Space Savings vs Phrase-Query Damage

cards.intuition: Case, accents, Unicode form, and punctuation rules decide which surface strings share one lookup key. Every merge discards a distinction.
cards.topic: Normalization: Case, Accents, and Equivalence Classes

cards.intuition: Store exact normalized forms for precision and folded variants for recall, then weight exact matches more strongly.
cards.formula: exact key + folded key, separately scored
cards.topic: Normalization: Case, Accents, and Equivalence Classes

cards.intuition: Normalized tokens are search keys, not the source. Citations, highlights, and faithful display require original characters and offsets.
cards.formula: source text remains authoritative; index terms are derived
